title: Day view stacks now shrink the class column a lot more; Home widgets reflow around a resize
summary: Opening an overlapping event stack in Day view previously only nudged the class column over a little (up to 68%, then 80% of the width for events). It now shrinks the class column down to a small fixed sliver the moment any stack is open, handing the vast majority of the width to the spread-out events, then springs back the instant every stack is collapsed again.

Resizing a widget on the Home screen used to just stop dead the moment it would touch a neighboring widget below or beside it. Growing a widget now pushes whatever's in its way further down, and shrinking one lets whatever's below slide up to close the gap -- both live as you drag, not just after you let go.
